Vayne

the Night Hunter

Vayne is a short-range hyper-carry who deals true damage every third hit. She's weak early, but in the late game her mobility and tank-shredding damage can take over fights. Hard to play and punishing to mistakes, but very rewarding. She got small buffs in 26.20.

⚖️ Compare with another champion · ⚔️ Look up a matchup

When to pick Vayne

✗ Better as a counter-pick

No. Her short range makes her easy to bully early, so pick her after seeing the enemy bot.

Pick into

  • Tank-heavy teams: Silver Bolts deal true damage
  • Melee divers she can condemn against walls
  • Weak early lanes she can survive, like Ezreal and Kalista

Avoid into

  • Long-range lanes that bully her early, like Caitlyn
  • Teams with lots of crowd control and burst
  • Strong early lanes like Miss Fortune and Samira

Great teammates

SorakaSoraka's healing helps her survive early.
NamiNami gives her sustain and crowd control.
MilioMilio gives her range and peel.

Your team needs: Pick Vayne when your team can protect her early and the enemy has tanks.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Silver Bolts' true damage every third hit shreds even the tankiest champions
  • Tumble gives mobility, and during Final Hour it also turns her invisible
  • Condemn stuns enemies against walls and pushes away divers
  • Huge late-game carry and dueling potential

Weaknesses

  • Very short attack range for a marksman
  • Weak early game against long-range lanes like Caitlyn
  • Vulnerable to crowd control and burst
  • Needs items to scale; a bad lane can leave her useless

Power spikes

  • Level 2: Silver Bolts and Tumble give short, sharp trades
  • Level 6: Final Hour makes you much stronger in fights
  • First item (Blade of The Ruined King): big damage, life steal and a slow
  • Two items (Guinsoo's Rageblade): attack speed and on-hit stack Silver Bolts faster
  • Three items (Terminus): you cut through armor and magic resist

Top tips

  • Condemn into walls for stuns
  • Tumble resets your attack: use it between autos
  • Silver Bolts shreds tanks, so focus one target
  • Final Hour makes Tumble invisible
  • Farm safely early; you scale late
  • Keep Condemn ready to peel divers
